youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Bakery phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the full bakery journey: browsing the cases and picking bread and croissants, asking about flavors, ingredients and allergens while tasting samples, ordering a custom birthday cake, then packing up, paying, joining the rewards card and catching pre-closing discounts. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! Am I too early today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ! æm aɪ tu ˈɜrli təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 早安！我現在來是不是太早了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, we just opened the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt æt ɔl, wi dʒʌst ˈoʊpənd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 一點也不，我們剛剛才開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that smell pulled me right in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ðæt smɛl pʊld mi raɪt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那股香味把我直接拉了進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We baked a fresh batch just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi beɪkt ə frɛʃ bætʃ dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們剛剛烤好了一爐新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh batch? That is the best news.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ bætʃ? ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst nuz./
dialogue.zh: 剛烤好的一爐？這真是太好的消息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I grab a basket for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡræb ə ˈbæskɪt fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我幫您拿個籃子好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a small basket, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə smɔl ˈbæskɪt, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 好，請給我一個小籃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ, teɪk jʊr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 給您，慢慢看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, I will look around first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθæŋk ju, aɪ wɪl lʊk əˈraʊnd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我先四處看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The loaves are in the cases on your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə loʊvz ɑr ɪn ðə ˈkeɪsɪz ɑn jʊr lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 麵包都在左邊的櫃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that whole row looks amazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðæt hoʊl roʊ lʊks əˈmeɪzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 噢，那一整排看起來太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Croissants are over on the right side.
dialogue.phonetic: /krwaˈsɑntz ɑr ˈoʊvər ɑn ðə raɪt saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 可頌在右邊那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I came here for croissants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪ keɪm hɪr fər krwaˈsɑntz./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我就是為了可頌來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have plain, almond, and chocolate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv pleɪn, ˈɑmənd, ænd ˈtʃɑklət./
dialogue.zh: 我們有原味、杏仁和巧克力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three kinds of croissants? Nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kaɪndz ʌv krwaˈsɑntz? naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 三種可頌？真不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The almond ones are our most popular.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɑmənd wʌnz ɑr ˈaʊər moʊst ˈpɑpjələr./
dialogue.zh: 杏仁款是我們最受歡迎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I should try those first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ʃʊd traɪ ðoz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 那我應該先試試那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are warm from the oven just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr wɔrm frʌm ði ˈʌvən dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它們剛出爐還溫熱著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm almond croissant, yes please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈɑmənd krwaˈsɑnt, jɛs pliz./
dialogue.zh: 熱呼呼的杏仁可頌，好，我要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set two aside for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt tu əˈsaɪd fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 我幫您先留下兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I see the price tags?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ si ðə praɪs tæɡz?/
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡可以看到價簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each little shelf card shows its price.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ ˈlɪtəl ʃɛlf kɑrd ʃoʊz ɪts praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 每層架子的小卡片都標示價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I like to see prices clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ laɪk tə si ˈpraɪsɪz ˈklɪrli./
dialogue.zh: 很好，我喜歡清楚看到價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big round one up top is sourdough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ raʊnd wʌn ʌp tɑp ɪz ˈsaʊərˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 最上面那個大圓麵包是酸種麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks great, do you bake it daily?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks ɡreɪt, du ju beɪk ɪt ˈdeɪli?/
dialogue.zh: 看起來很棒，你們天天烤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a day, so it stays fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ə deɪ, soʊ ɪt steɪz frɛʃ./
dialogue.zh: 一天烤兩次，所以能保持新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also have rye or multigrain?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔlsoʊ hæv raɪ ɔr ˈmʌltiˌɡreɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 你們也有黑麥或五穀麵包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are stacked behind the croissant tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr stækt bɪˈhɑnd ðə krwaˈsɑnt treɪ./
dialogue.zh: 兩款都疊放在可頌盤後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love a good multigrain sandwich.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ə ɡʊd ˈmʌltiˌɡreɪn ˈsænwɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我很愛好吃的五穀三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The baguettes are right behind you too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæɡˈɛts ɑr raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ju tu./
dialogue.zh: 法式長棍也在您身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I did not see those yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, aɪ dɪd nɑt si ðoz jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 噢，我剛剛沒看到那些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They come in classic and sesame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kʌm ɪn ˈklæsɪk ænd ˈsɛsəmi./
dialogue.zh: 有經典原味和芝麻款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sesame sounds nice, I will take one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛsəmi saʊndz naɪs, aɪ wɪl teɪk wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 芝麻的聽起來不錯，我拿一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stay best until around noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ steɪ bɛst ənˈtɪl əˈraʊnd nun./
dialogue.zh: 它們最好在中午前享用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pastries in that case look so fancy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪstriz ɪn ðæt keɪs lʊk soʊ ˈfænsi./
dialogue.zh: 那個櫃裡的糕點看起來好精緻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That case holds the cream and fruit items.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt keɪs hoʊldz ðə krim ænd frut ˈaɪtmz./
dialogue.zh: 那個櫃子放的是奶油和水果類點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fruit tart is calling my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frut tɑrt ɪz ˈkɔlɪŋ maɪ neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 水果塔在呼喚我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a seasonal flavor this month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈsizənəl ˈfleɪvər ðɪs mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 這是這個月的季節限定口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seasonal means I must try it, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsizənəl minz aɪ mʌst traɪ ɪt, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 季節限定就代表我非試不可，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, a small board lists today's specials.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ə smɔl bɔrd lɪsts təˈdeɪz ˈspɛʃəlz./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有塊小板子寫著今天的特賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find that special board?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ faɪnd ðæt ˈspɛʃəl bɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡可以找到那塊特賣板？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs right above the register there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæŋz raɪt əˈbʌv ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 就掛在那邊收銀台的正上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I open a bag and sniff first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈoʊpən ə bæɡ ænd snɪf fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以先打開袋子聞一聞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, smelling is part of the fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ˈsmɛlɪŋ ɪz pɑrt ʌv ðə fʌn./
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，聞香也是樂趣之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cinnamon roll smells incredible here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsɪnəmən roʊl smɛlz ɪnˈkrɛdəbəl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這個肉桂捲聞起來太不可思議了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We bake those every single morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi beɪk ðoz ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們每天早晨都烤這一爐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No wonder the smell pulled me inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwʌndər ðə smɛl pʊld mi ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 難怪香味把我拉了進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The window tray is always the newest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ treɪ ɪz ˈɔlweɪz ðə ˈnuziɪst./
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那一盤永遠是最新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So those are the freshest options?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðoz ɑr ðə ˈfrɛʃəst ˈɑpʃənz?/
dialogue.zh: 所以那些是最新鮮的選擇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we rotate them through the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi roʊˈteɪt ðəm θru ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們整天輪換補新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will start with the window side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl stɑrt wɪð ði ˈwɪndoʊ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那我就從窗邊那一側開始挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a tray of mini muffins waits there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə treɪ ʌv ˈmɪni ˈmʌfɪnz weɪts ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 那邊還有一盤迷你瑪芬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mini muffins are perfect for coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪni ˈmʌfɪnz ɑr ˈpɜrfɪkt fər ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 迷你瑪芬配咖啡最完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They come in blueberry and banana.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kʌm ɪn ˈbluˌbɛri ænd bəˈnænə./
dialogue.zh: 有藍莓和香蕉口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blueberry is my all time favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbluˌbɛri ɪz maɪ ɔl taɪm ˈfeɪvərɪt./
dialogue.zh: 藍莓是我一直以來的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The darker loaves sit on the lower shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑrkər loʊvz sɪt ɑn ðə ˈloʊər ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 顏色深的麵包放在下層架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That rye loaf looks nice and dense.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt raɪ loʊf lʊks naɪs ænd dɛns./
dialogue.zh: 那個黑麥麵包看起來扎實綿密。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dense rye keeps you full for hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛns raɪ kips ju fʊl fər ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 紮實的黑麥讓你飽足幾個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full for hours? That is what I need.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl fər ˈaʊərz? ðæt ɪz wɑt aɪ nid./
dialogue.zh: 飽足幾小時？那正是我需要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sell it by the whole loaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛl ɪt baɪ ðə hoʊl loʊf./
dialogue.zh: 我們是一整條在賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A whole loaf is fine, friends come tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl loʊf ɪz faɪn, frɛndz kʌm təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一整條剛好，朋友們今晚要來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would you like it sliced for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk ɪt slaɪst fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 需要幫您切片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please slice it not too thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pliz slaɪs ɪt nɑt tu θɪk./
dialogue.zh: 好，請切得不要太厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can cut it thin or medium.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn kʌt ɪt θɪn ɔr ˈmidiəm./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以切薄片或中等厚度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium is good for my sandwich maker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm ɪz ɡʊd fər maɪ ˈsænwɪtʃ ˈmekər./
dialogue.zh: 中等厚度剛適合我的三明治機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We also have soft drinks and cold milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlsoʊ hæv sɔft drɪŋks ænd koʊld mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 我們也有飲料和冷藏牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold milk with bread? Show me that fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld mɪlk wɪð brɛd? ʃoʊ mi ðæt frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 麵包配牛奶？帶我去看那台冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the door: juices, milk, and yogurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔr: ˈdʒusɪz, mɪlk, ænd ˈjoɡərt./
dialogue.zh: 就在門邊：有果汁、牛奶和優格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love an iced coffee with my roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ən aɪst ˈkɔfi wɪð maɪ roʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡我的麵包捲配冰咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The barista stands at the back counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæˈɪstə stændz æt ðə bæk ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡師在後面的櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That twisted one with the salt looks great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtwɪstɪd wʌn wɪð ðə sɔlt lʊks ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那個撒了鹽的扭結麵包看起來很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are pretzel buns, baked this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ɑr ˈprɛtsəl bʌnz, beɪkt ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那是椒鹽捲，今天早上剛烤的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they soft inside and crisp out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðeɪ sɔft ɪnˈsaɪd ænd krɪsp aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 它們是裡面軟、外面脆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, warmed up they taste even better.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɔrmd ʌp ðeɪ teɪst ˈivən ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 對，加熱之後吃起來更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crisp outside is what I always look for.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɪsp ˈaʊtˌsaɪd ɪz wɑt aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz lʊk fər./
dialogue.zh: 外脆的麵包就是我一直在找的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want it toasted? We toast anything here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ɪt ˈtoʊstɪd? wi toʊst ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 要幫您烤一下嗎？我們什麼都能烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can toast a croissant too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn toʊst ə krwaˈsɑnt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 可頌也可以烤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we toast it light or golden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, wi toʊst ɪt laɪt ɔr ˈɡoʊldən./
dialogue.zh: 當然，可以烤到微黃或金黃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Golden sounds perfect with butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡoʊldən saʊndz ˈpɜrfɪkt wɪð ˈbʌtər./
dialogue.zh: 金黃的配上奶油聽起來很完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter comes free with every toasted order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtər kʌmz fri wɪð ˈɛvri ˈtoʊstɪd ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 每一份現烤的都附奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, salted or unsalted butter?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ˈsɔltɪd ɔr ʌnˈsɔltɪd ˈbʌtər?/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，有鹽還是無鹽奶油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have both right at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv boʊθ raɪt æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 兩種我們櫃台上都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little of each, I cannot choose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ʌv itʃ, aɪ ˈkænɑt tʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 每樣來一點，我選不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jam station is next to the butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒæm ˈsteɪʃən ɪz nɛkst tə ðə ˈbʌtər./
dialogue.zh: 果醬台就在奶油旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, do you make your own jam?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, du ju meɪk jʊr oʊn dʒæm?/
dialogue.zh: 噢，果醬是你們自製的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, strawberry and apricot are house made.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈstrɔˌbɛri ænd ˈæprɪˌkɑt ɑr haʊs meɪd./
dialogue.zh: 對，草莓和杏子醬是自製的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: House made jam always tastes better.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊs meɪd dʒæm ˈɔlˌweɪz teɪsts ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 自製果醬總是比較好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New this week: chocolate filled donuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ðɪs wik: ˈtʃɑklət fɪld ˈdonəts./
dialogue.zh: 這週新品：巧克力內餡甜甜圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have them with sprinkles too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðəm wɪð ˈsprɪŋkəlz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 也有帶糖珠的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, rainbow sprinkles on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ˈreɪnˌboʊ ˈsprɪŋkəlz ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 當然，上面有彩虹糖珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My niece would love these so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nis wʊd lʌv ðiz soʊ mʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我姪女一定會超喜歡這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wrap donuts in small paper boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ræp ˈdonəts ɪn smɔl ˈpeɪpər ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我們用小紙盒裝甜甜圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A box of six would be just right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɑks ʌv sɪks wʊd bi dʒʌst raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一盒六個剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pick any six you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn pɪk ˈɛni sɪks ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 您可以隨便挑六個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will choose three chocolate and three plain.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tʃuz θri ˈtʃɑklət ænd θri pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我要選三個巧克力三個原味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a very smart combination.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈvɛri smɑrt ˌkɑmbəˈneɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 這個搭配非常聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I want everyone to be happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, aɪ wɑnt ˈɛvriwʌn tə bi ˈhæpi./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我想讓大家都開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the hardest part of a bakery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈhɑrdəst pɑrt ʌv ə ˈbekəri./
dialogue.zh: 這正是麵包店最難的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything looks so good I want it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ lʊks soʊ ɡʊd aɪ wɑnt ɪt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 每樣看起來都太好，我全想要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything catch your eye so far?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ kætʃ jʊr aɪ soʊ fɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 目前有心儀的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I still cannot decide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli, aɪ stɪl ˈkænɑt dɪˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我還是無法決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fruit tart is very popular today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frut tɑrt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpɑpjələr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 水果塔今天非常受歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask what is inside the fruit tart?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk wɑt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə frut tɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 請問水果塔裡面是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vanilla cream and fresh seasonal fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /vəˈnɪlə krim ænd frɛʃ ˈsizənəl frut./
dialogue.zh: 香草奶油和新鮮的季節水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, my family avoids heavy cream.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd, maɪ ˈfæməli əˈvɔɪdz ˈhɛvi krim./
dialogue.zh: 那很好，我們家人不吃厚重奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is light, whipped with real vanilla.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz laɪt, wɪpt wɪð riəl vəˈnɪlə./
dialogue.zh: 它很輕盈，用真正的香草打發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it very sweet or mildly sweet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈvɛri swit ɔr ˈmaɪdli swit?/
dialogue.zh: 它是很甜還是微甜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mildly sweet, the fruit brings most flavor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmaɪdli swit, ðə frut brɪŋz moʊst ˈfleɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 微甜，味道大多是水果帶來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mild suits me, nobody likes sugar bombs.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪd sutz mi, ˈnoʊˌbɑdi laɪks ˈʃʊɡər bɑmz./
dialogue.zh: 微甜正合我意，沒人愛死甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lately many customers ask for less sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtli ˈmɛnɪ ˈkʌstəmərz æsk fər lɛs ˈʃʊɡər./
dialogue.zh: 最近很多客人都要求少糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is inside the cinnamon roll?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈsɪnəmən roʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 肉桂捲裡麵包的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown sugar, cinnamon, and a cream glaze.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn ˈʃʊɡər, ˈsɪnəmən, ænd ə krim ɡleɪz./
dialogue.zh: 紅糖、肉桂，還有一層奶油糖霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the glaze stay only on the top?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ɡleɪz steɪ ˈoʊnli ɑn ðə tɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 糖霜只留在最上面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it soaks inside while the roll is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt sɔks ɪnˈsaɪd waɪl ðə roʊl ɪz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 不是，捲還熱的時候糖霜會滲進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds rich, is one roll enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz rɪtʃ, ɪz wʌn roʊl ɪˈnʌf?/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很濃郁，一個捲夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is plenty, especially with coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪz ˈplɛnti, əˈspɛʃəli wɪð ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 一個就很多了，尤其配咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the almond croissants have real nuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ði ˈɑmənd krwaˈsɑntz hæv riəl nʌts?/
dialogue.zh: 杏仁可頌裡面有真正的堅果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, almond paste and toasted slices.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɑmənd peɪst ænd ˈtoʊstɪd ˈslaɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 有，杏仁醬和烤杏仁片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our oldest boy is allergic to nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈoʊldɪst bɔɪ ɪz əˈlɜrdʒɪk tə nʌts./
dialogue.zh: 我們家最大的兒子對堅果過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then avoid everything with the brown tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn əˈvɔɪd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wɪð ðə braʊn tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 那請避開所有掛棕色標籤的食品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which items carry that brown tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈaɪtmz ˈkæri ðæt braʊn tæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 哪些商品掛那個棕色標籤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The nut loaf, the macarons, and the twist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nʌt loʊf, ðə ˈmækəˌrɑnz, ænd ðə twɪst./
dialogue.zh: 堅果麵包、馬卡龍和捲心酥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the plain loaves touch the nut ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə pleɪn loʊvz tʌtʃ ðə nʌt wʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 原味麵包會碰到堅果類的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, we bake them on separate trays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər, wi beɪk ðəm ɑn ˈsɛpərət treɪz./
dialogue.zh: 絕不會，我們用分開的烤盤烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the sourdough and the rye vegan?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈsaʊərˌdoʊ ænd ðə raɪ ˈviˌɡən?/
dialogue.zh: 酸種麵包和黑麥麵包是全素的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sourdough is, but the rye has honey.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsaʊərˌdoʊ ɪz, bʌt ðə raɪ hæz ˈhʌni./
dialogue.zh: 酸種是，但黑麥加了蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honey instead of sugar? That is clever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌni ɪnˈstɛd ʌv ˈʃʊɡər? ðæt ɪz ˈklɛvər./
dialogue.zh: 用蜂蜜代替糖？真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives the rye a soft gentle sweetness.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɪvz ðə raɪ ə sɔft ˈdʒɛntəl ˈswitnəs./
dialogue.zh: 它讓黑麥有一種柔和的清甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the little dinner rolls contain egg?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈdɪnər roʊlz kənˈten ɛɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 小圓麵包裡有蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, egg and milk make them fluffy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɛɡ ænd mɪlk meɪk ðəm ˈflʌfi./
dialogue.zh: 有，蛋和牛奶讓它們很鬆軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter cannot have eggs at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɔtər ˈkænɑt hæv ɛɡz ət ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我女兒完全不能吃蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the baguettes and sourdough are safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bæˈɡɛts ænd ˈsaʊərˌdoʊ ɑr seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 那長棍和酸種麵包是可以吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, she can eat those with dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ʃi kæn it ðoz wɪð ˈdɪnər./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，她晚餐可以吃那些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We mark every egg free item clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mɑrk ˈɛvri ɛɡ fri ˈaɪtəm ˈklɪrli./
dialogue.zh: 我們每個無蛋商品都標得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you carry anything gluten free?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈkæri ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ ˈɡlutən fri?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有無麩質的食品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a rice loaf and corn muffins.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə raɪs loʊf ænd kɔrn ˈmʌfɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 有，米麵包和玉米瑪芬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep those special items?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju kip ðoz ˈspɛʃəl ˈaɪtmz?/
dialogue.zh: 那些特別的食品放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the small fridge by the door, sealed tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə smɔl frɪdʒ baɪ ðə dɔr, sild taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在門邊的小冰箱裡，密封好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they baked in your kitchen too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðeɪ beɪkt ɪn jʊr ˈkɪtʃən tu?/
dialogue.zh: 它們也是你們廚房烤的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a separate bakery makes them daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ə ˈsɛpərət ˈbeɪkəri meɪks ðəm ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 不是，由另一間麵包店每天製作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is exactly what parents need to hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wɑt ˈpɛrənts nid tə hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這正是爸媽最想聽到的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food allergies matter, we take them seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /fud əˈlɜrdʒiz ˈmætər, wi teɪk ðəm ˈsɪriəsli./
dialogue.zh: 食物過敏很重要，我們很認真對待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I try a sample of the twist?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ traɪ ə ˈsæmpəl ʌv ðə twɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以試吃一塊捲心酥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is a warm piece for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, hɪr ɪz ə wɔrm pis fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 當然，這塊還溫的給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wow, the inside is so soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ, ði ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz soʊ sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 哇，裡面好軟啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fluffy texture is our pride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈflʌfi ˈtɛkstʃər ɪz ɑʊr praɪd./
dialogue.zh: 這種鬆軟口感是我們的驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It almost melts in my mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlˌmoʊst mɛlts ɪn maɪ maʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 它幾乎在我嘴裡化開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should taste it with plain tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʃʊd teɪst ɪt wɪð pleɪn ti./
dialogue.zh: 你應該配清茶嚐嚐看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do most people find it too sweet?
dialogue.phonetic: /du moʊst ˈpipəl faɪnd ɪt tu swit?/
dialogue.zh: 大部分人會覺得它太甜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most say the sweetness is just right.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst seɪ ðə ˈswitnəs ɪz dʒʌst raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 多數人說甜度剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will take two of these.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl teɪk tu ʌv ðiz./
dialogue.zh: 那我要拿兩個這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two twists, I will add them now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu twɪsts, aɪ wɪl ˈæd ðɛm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 兩個捲心酥，我現在幫您加上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I taste the house made jam?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪst ðə haʊs meɪd dʒæm?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以試吃自製果醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, a clean spoon sits on the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ə klin spun sɪts ɑn ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 當然，小板上有乾淨的勺子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This apricot jam is absolutely amazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈæprɪˌkɑt dʒæm ɪz ˈæbsəˌlutli əˈmeɪzɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這個杏子果醬實在太好吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cook it with fruit from local farms.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊk ɪt wɪð frut frʌm ˈloʊkəl fɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 我們用本地農場的水果熬製。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days does it keep once open?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛnɪ deɪz dʌz ɪt kip wʌns ˈoʊpən?/
dialogue.zh: 開封後能放幾天呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two weeks in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tu wiks ɪn ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 放冰箱大約兩星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will buy one jar of apricot then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ wʌn dʒɑr ʌv ˈæprɪˌkɑt ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我買一瓶杏子醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wonderful choice for morning toast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwʌndərfəl tʃɔɪz fər ˈmɔrnɪŋ toʊst./
dialogue.zh: 配早餐吐司是絕佳選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I also try the blueberry muffin?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ traɪ ðə ˈbluˌbɛri ˈmʌfɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以試試藍莓瑪芬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I cut you a corner piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, aɪ kʌt ju ə ˈkɔrnər pis./
dialogue.zh: 給，我切一塊邊緣的給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The berries inside are really big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɛriz ɪnˈsaɪd ɑr ˈrɪəli bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 裡面的藍莓真的很大顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use whole fruit, never just flavoring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi juz hoʊl frut, ˈnɛvər dʒʌst ˈfleɪvərɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們用完整水果，從不用香精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I store bread at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ʃʊd aɪ stɔr brɛd æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我在家裡該怎麼保存麵包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bread box or a cloth bag works best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə brɛd bɑks ɔr ə klɔθ bæɡ wɜrks bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 麵包盒或棉布袋最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I put it inside the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊt ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə frɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我該放進冰箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fridge dries bread out faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə frɪdʒ draɪz brɛd aʊt ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 不，冰箱會讓麵包更快變乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? I always stored it there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪəli? aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈstɔrd ɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我以前都那樣放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Freeze whatever you cannot finish instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /friz wɛtˈɛvər ju ˈkænɑt ˈfɪnɪʃ ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 吃不完的改為冷凍比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does freezing work for sliced loaves?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ˈfrizɪŋ wɜrk fər slaɪst loʊvz?/
dialogue.zh: 切片的麵包適合冷凍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, toast the slices straight from frozen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, toʊst ðə ˈslaɪsɪz streɪt frʌm ˈfroʊzən./
dialogue.zh: 可以，凍著直接烤就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a lifesaver for busy mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvər fər ˈbɪzi ˈmɔrnɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 這對忙碌的早晨太幫忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rye stays good three days like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪ steɪz ɡʊd θri deɪz laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 黑麥麵包那樣可以放三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the croissants, how long do they last?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə krwaˈsɑntz, haʊ lɔŋ du ðeɪ læst?/
dialogue.zh: 可頌呢，能放多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best the same day, warm them briefly.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ðə seɪm deɪ, wɔrm ðəm ˈbrifli./
dialogue.zh: 當天吃最好，稍微加熱即可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the right way to warm one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ðə raɪt weɪ tə wɔrm wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 正確的加熱方式是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes in a low warm oven.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ɪn ə loʊ wɔrm ˈʌvən./
dialogue.zh: 放低溫烤爐裡烤五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the fruit tart last till Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə frut tɑrt læst tɪl ˈsʌnˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 水果塔可以放到星期日嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the coldest fridge shelf, yes it will.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ˈkoʊldəst frɪdʒ ʃɛlf, jɛs ɪt wɪl./
dialogue.zh: 放冰箱最冷的層架，可以的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two days is plenty for our family.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz ɪz ˈplɛnti fər ˈaʊər ˈfæməli./
dialogue.zh: 兩天對我們家來說足夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cream items never wait long in this house.
dialogue.phonetic: /krim ˈaɪtmz ˈnɛvər weɪt lɔŋ ɪn ðɪs haʊs./
dialogue.zh: 奶油類點心在我家店從來留不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were these sesame bagels boiled first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜr ðiz ˈsɛsəmi ˈbeɪɡəlz boɪld fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 這些芝麻貝果是先煮過的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, boiled then baked, hear that crunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, boɪld ðɛn beɪkt, hɪr ðæt krʌntʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 對，先煮後烤，聽見那聲脆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My whole family is fine with sesame.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊl ˈfæməli ɪz faɪn wɪð ˈsɛsəmi./
dialogue.zh: 我們全家吃芝麻都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then grab the top two, they look prettiest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡræb ðə tɑp tu, ðeɪ lʊk ˈprɪtiɪst./
dialogue.zh: 那就拿最上面兩個，它們最好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the donuts have milk in them?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈdoʊnəts hæv mɪlk ɪn ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 甜甜圈裡有牛奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the dough holds milk and butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə doʊ hoʊldz mɪlk ænd ˈbʌtər./
dialogue.zh: 有，麵團裡有牛奶和奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nephew cannot drink milk sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈnɛfju ˈkænɑt drɪŋk mɪlk ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 可惜我侄子不能喝牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the jam sandwich cookies suit him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə dʒæm ˈsænwɪtʃ ˈkʊkiz sut hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那果醬夾心餅乾適合他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jam cookies? Please show me those.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒæm ˈkʊkiz? pliz ʃoʊ mi ðoz./
dialogue.zh: 果醬餅乾？請給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, two crisp layers with apricot.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr, tu krɪsp ˈleɪərz wɪð ˈæprɪˌkɑt./
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，兩層酥餅夾杏子醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These taste like my grandmother's kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz teɪst laɪk maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðərz ˈkɪtʃən./
dialogue.zh: 這味道像我奶奶的廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old recipes always sell out the fastest.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈrɛsəpɪz ˈɔlˌweɪz sɛl aʊt ðə ˈfæstɪst./
dialogue.zh: 老配方總是賣得最快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dozen of these cookies for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdʌzən ʌv ðiz ˈkʊkiz fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 請給我十二個這種餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dozen cookies, boxed up neatly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdʌzən ˈkʊkiz, bɑkst ʌp ˈnitli./
dialogue.zh: 一打餅乾，整整齊齊裝盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the snack problem is solved.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə snæk ˈprɑbləm ɪz sɑldv./
dialogue.zh: 零食問題現在解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything else going into your basket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ ɛls ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɪntu jʊr ˈbæskɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 還要往籃子裡放別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, we still need a birthday cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt, wi stɪl nid ə ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 對了，我們還缺一個生日蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, walk with me to the cake table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndərfəl, wɔk wɪð mi tə ðə keɪk ˈtæbəl./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，跟我走到蛋糕桌那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take custom cake orders here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk ˈkʌstəm keɪk ˈɔrdərz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡接客製蛋糕訂單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we bake them every single week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi beɪk ðəm ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl wik./
dialogue.zh: 接，我們每個星期都在烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I see the cake photos?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ si ðə keɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡可以看到蛋糕照片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This folder holds all our past cakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈfoʊldər hoʊldz ɔl ˈaʊər pæst keɪks./
dialogue.zh: 這個資料夾放著我們從前烤的蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, so many beautiful designs here.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, soʊ ˈmɛnɪ ˈbjutəfəl dɪˈzaɪnz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 哇，這麼多漂亮的設計。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page two has the kids' favorites.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ tu hæz ðə kɪdz ˈfeɪvərɪts./
dialogue.zh: 第二頁是小朋友最喜歡的款式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These little animal cakes are adorable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈlɪtəl ˈænɪməl keɪks ɑr əˈdɔrəbəl./
dialogue.zh: 這些小動物蛋糕太可愛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our baker pipes each one by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbeɪkər paɪps itʃ wʌn baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 我們的麵包師傅每個都是手工擠花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does a simple cake cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ə ˈsɪmpəl keɪk kɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 一個簡單的蛋糕要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain ones start at twenty five dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn wʌnz stɑrt æt ˈtwɛnti faɪv ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 樸素款從二十五美元起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the fully decorated ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈfʊli ˈdɛkəˌreɪtɪd wʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 那完全裝飾過的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those run from forty dollars upward.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz rʌn frʌm ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz ˈʌpwərd./
dialogue.zh: 那些從四十美元起跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My budget is around fifty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt ɪz əˈraʊnd ˈfɪfti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 我的預算大約五十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That gets a lovely two tier cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡɛts ə ˈlʌvli tu tɪr keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 那可以買到漂亮的兩層蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two tiers, is that enough for ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tɪrz, ɪz ðæt ɪˈnʌf fər tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 兩層，夠十個人吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It serves twelve, with a few slices left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɜrvz twɛlv, wɪð ə fju ˈslaɪsɪz lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 夠十二個人吃，還會剩幾片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, ten kids plus my wife and me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, tɛn kɪdz plʌz maɪ waɪf ænd mi./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，十個小孩加上我和我太太。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Children love the chocolate sponge best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪldrən lʌv ðə ˈtʃɑklət spʌndʒ bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 小朋友最愛的就是巧克力海綿蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the sponge be vanilla instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə spʌndʒ bi vəˈnɪlə ɪnˈstɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕體可以改成香草味嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, vanilla or classic yellow cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, vəˈnɪlə ɔr ˈklæsɪk ˈjɛloʊ keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，香草或經典黃蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yellow cake sounds like my childhood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛloʊ keɪk saʊndz laɪk maɪ ˈtʃaɪldˌhʊd./
dialogue.zh: 黃蛋糕聽起來像我的童年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is soft with a buttery crumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz sɔft wɪð ə ˈbʌtəri krʌm./
dialogue.zh: 它口感柔軟，帶著奶油香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What fillings can I choose from?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ˈfɪlɪŋz kæn aɪ tʃuz frʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 夾心我可以選哪些？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jam, fresh cream, or chocolate ganache.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒæm, frɛʃ krim, ɔr ˈtʃɑklət ɡəˈnæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 果醬、鮮奶油，或巧克力甘納許。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ganache? Is that a rich one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡəˈnæʃ? ɪz ðæt ə rɪtʃ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 甘納許？那個是不是很濃郁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so we often pair it with jam.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, soʊ wi ˈɔfən pɛr ɪt wɪð dʒæm./
dialogue.zh: 是，所以我們常配果醬一起用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strawberry jam with yellow cake then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstrɔˌbɛri dʒæm wɪð ˈjɛloʊ keɪk ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就草莓果醬配黃蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A classic, sweet yet very light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈklæsɪk, swit jɛt ˈvɛri laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 經典搭配，甜卻不死膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you make it less sweet overall?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju meɪk ɪt lɛs swit ˈoʊvərˌɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 整體可以做少一點甜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we simply reduce the sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, wi ˈsɪmpli rɪˈdus ðə ˈʃʊɡər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們直接減糖就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep it only lightly sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kip ɪt ˈoʊnli ˈlaɪtli swit./
dialogue.zh: 請做成微甜就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, light sugar inside the cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd, laɪt ˈʃʊɡər ɪnˈsaɪd ðə keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 記下了，蛋糕內減糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the outside frosting?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt əˈbaʊt ði ˈaʊtˌsaɪd ˈfrɔstɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 那外面的糖霜呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buttercream, whipped cream, or smooth fondant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtərˌkrim, wɪpt krim, ɔr smuθ ˈfɑndɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 奶油霜、鮮奶油或光滑的翻糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fondant is that soft sugar skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑndɑnt ɪz ðæt sɔft ˈʃʊɡər skɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 翻糖就是那層軟軟的糖皮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and it holds bright colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ænd ɪt hoʊldz braɪt ˈkʌlərz./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，而且它顯色很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My niece wishes for a rainbow cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nis wɪʃɪz fər ə ˈreɪnˌboʊ keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我姪女想要一個彩虹蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can dye six layers inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn daɪ sɪks ˈleɪərz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把裡面六層染色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six colors hidden inside? That will wow her.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈkʌlərz ˈhɪdən ɪnˈsaɪd? ðæt wɪl waʊ hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 裡面藏六種顏色？她一定會驚呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rainbow cakes never fail at parties.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈreɪnˌboʊ keɪks ˈnɛvər feɪl æt ˈpɑrtiz./
dialogue.zh: 派對上彩虹蛋糕從來不失手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which frosting suits the rainbow best?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈfrɔstɪŋ suts ðə ˈreɪnˌboʊ bɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 哪種糖霜最配彩虹？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buttercream gives a smooth pastel look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtərˌkrim ɡɪvz ə smuθ ˈpæstəl lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 奶油霜會呈現柔和的粉彩色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pastels sound dreamy, let us do those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpæstəlz saʊnd ˈdrimi, lɛt ʌs du ðoz./
dialogue.zh: 粉彩色聽起來好夢幻，就用那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft rainbow outside, bright rainbow inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ˈreɪnˌboʊ ˈaʊtˌsaɪd, braɪt ˈreɪnˌboʊ ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 外面柔和彩虹，裡面鮮豔彩虹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you write words on the cake?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju raɪt wɜrdz ɑn ðə keɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 你們可以在蛋糕上寫字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we pipe messages in chocolate gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi paɪp ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz ɪn ˈtʃɑklət dʒɛl./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們用巧克力膠擠字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write Happy Birthday, little Mia.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈhæpi ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ, ˈlɪtəl ˈmiə./
dialogue.zh: 寫「生日快樂，小米雅」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How is Mia spelled, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ˈmiɪ spɛld, pliz?/
dialogue.zh: 請問米雅怎麼拼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: M as in Mary, then I, then A.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛm æz ɪn ˈmɛri, ðɛn aɪ, ðɛn eɪ./
dialogue.zh: M 像 Mary 的 M，然後 I，再 A。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: M I A, got it perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛm aɪ eɪ, gɑt ɪt ˈpɜrfɪktli./
dialogue.zh: M-I-A，完全記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please add tiny stars around the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz æd ˈtaɪni stɑrz əˈraʊnd ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 請在頂部周圍加小星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stars along the upper edge?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrz əˈlɔŋ ði ˈʌpər ɛdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 沿著上面的邊圍一圈？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, gold ones would feel magical.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡoʊld wʌnz wʊd fil ˈmædʒɪkəl./
dialogue.zh: 對，金色的會感覺很魔幻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use edible gold dust for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi juz ˈɛdəbəl ɡoʊld dʌst fər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我們用可食用金粉來做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do candles come with the order?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈkændəlz kʌm wɪð ði ˈɔrdər?/
dialogue.zh: 訂單附蠟燭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have number and classic candles.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ˈnʌmbər ænd ˈklæsɪk ˈkændəlz./
dialogue.zh: 我們有數字蠟燭和一般蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She turns five this coming Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi tɜrnz faɪv ðɪs ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈsʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 她這週日要滿五歲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a shining number five candle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə ˈʃaɪnɪŋ ˈnʌmbər faɪv ˈkændəl./
dialogue.zh: 那就一支閃亮的數字五蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the cake be completely nut safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə keɪk bi kɑmˈplitli nʌt seɪf?/
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕可以完全不含堅果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our cake room never touches nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər keɪk rum ˈnɛvər ˈtʌtʃɪz nʌts./
dialogue.zh: 我們的蛋糕間從不碰堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That takes a weight off, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt teɪks ə weɪt ɔf, ˈθæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 那我就放心了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every cake we sell is nut free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri keɪk wi sɛl ɪz nʌt fri./
dialogue.zh: 我們賣的每個蛋糕都不含堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any dairy or egg worries too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪ ˈdɛri ɔr ɛɡ ˈwɜriz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 乳品或蛋的問題也有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This cake does hold milk and egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs keɪk dʌz hoʊld mɪlk ænd ɛɡ./
dialogue.zh: 這個蛋糕確實含牛奶和蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My girl skips eggs, the rest eat both.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡɜrl skɪps ɛɡz, ðə rɛst it boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 我女兒不吃蛋，其他人都照樣吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the yellow cake is perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈjɛloʊ keɪk ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 那黃蛋糕就非常合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we pick the cake up?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn kæn wi pɪk ðə keɪk ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我們什麼時候可以取蛋糕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday morning, sometime after eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ, ˈsʌmˌtaɪm ˈæftər eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 星期天早上，八點以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The party begins at one sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɑrti bɪˈɡɪnz æt wʌn ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 派對一點準時開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We bake it fresh Saturday late.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi beɪk ɪt frɛʃ ˈsætərˌdeɪ leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們週六晚些現烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it is made that very weekend?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt ɪz meɪd ðæt ˈvɛri ˈwikˌɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 所以就是那個週末現做的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it cools overnight for Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt kʊlz ˈoʊvərˌnaɪt fər ˈsʌnˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，涼一夜之後專為週日備著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time exactly will it be ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt taɪm ɪɡˈzæktli wɪl ɪt bi ˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 確切幾點會好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By nine, fully cooled and boxed.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ naɪn, ˈfʊli kuld ænd bɑkst./
dialogue.zh: 九點前，完全冷卻並裝盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine works great for our errands.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn wɜrks ɡreɪt fər ˈaʊər ˈɛrəndz./
dialogue.zh: 九點很剛好，我們要辦事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will text the moment it is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl tɛkst ðə ˈmoʊmənt ɪt ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 烤好後我們立刻發訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pay now or at pickup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ peɪ naʊ ɔr æt ˈpɪkˌʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在付還是取貨時付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a ten dollar deposit today.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə tɛn ˈdɑlər dɪˈpɑzɪt təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天先付十美元訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paying the deposit by card is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪɪŋ ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt baɪ kɑrd ɪz ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 用卡付訂金很方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rest gets settled when you arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛst ɡɛts ˈsɛtəld wɛn ju əˈraɪv./
dialogue.zh: 剩下的到時候再結清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we change the message tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ təˈmɑroʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 明天可以改上面的字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, any change before Friday noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ˈɛni tʃeɪndʒ bɪˈfɔr ˈfraɪˌdeɪ nun./
dialogue.zh: 可以，星期五中午前都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, kids pick new words daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, kɪdz pɪk nju wɜrdz ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 好，小孩天天換新台詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Little bosses change their minds often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl ˈbɔsəz tʃeɪndʒ ðɛr maɪndz ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 小老闆們心思變得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I carry a cake safely?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ˈkæri ə keɪk ˈseɪfli?/
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕要怎麼安全地搬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our box sits on a flat base.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər bɑks sɪts ɑn ə flæt beɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我們的盒下有平底托。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat on the seat, not on laps?
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ɑn ðə sit, nɑt ɑn læps?/
dialogue.zh: 平放在座位上，不能抱腿上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never on laps over bumps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ɑn læps ˈoʊvər bʌmps./
dialogue.zh: 千萬別抱著過顛簸路段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it need the fridge right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt nid ðə frɪdʒ raɪt əˈweɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 要馬上放冰箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chill it within two hours, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪl ɪt wɪˈðɪn tu ˈaʊərz, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請在兩小時內冷藏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the car gets warm inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə kɑr ɡɛts wɔrm ɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果車內變熱怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frosting softens fast when it gets warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfrɔstɪŋ ˈsɔfənz fæst wɛn ɪt ɡɛts wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 糖霜一遇到熱就化得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will drive straight home first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl draɪv streɪt hoʊm fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 那我先直接開回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or straight to the party, both fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr streɪt tə ðə ˈpɑrti, boʊθ faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 或直接去派對，都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, a cake knife?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ, ə keɪk naɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，有蛋糕刀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wooden knife rides free inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwʊdən naɪv raɪdz fri ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 盒內免費附一把木刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You truly thought of everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈtruli θɔt ʌv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你們真的很週到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me print the order card now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi prɪnt ði ˈɔrdər kɑrd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在幫你印訂單卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I want to check it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ wɑnt tə tʃɛk ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好，我想再確認一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Size, flavor, message, and Sunday nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪz, ˈfleɪvər, ˈmɛsɪdʒ, ænd ˈsʌnˌdeɪ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 尺寸、口味、字句，週日九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us go pay for everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ peɪ fər ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們去把所有東西結帳吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your basket, plus the cake deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈbæskɪt, plʌz ðə keɪk dɪˈpɑzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你的籃子，外加蛋糕訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pay by card today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl peɪ baɪ kɑrd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我今天要刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Credit or debit, both work fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɛdɪt ɔr ˈdɛbɪt, boʊθ wɜrk faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 信用卡簽帳卡都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Credit. Should I tap or insert?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɛdɪt. ʃʊd aɪ tæp ɔr ɪnˈsɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 信用卡。用感應還是插卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tap it on the little reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tæp ɪt ɑn ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈridər./
dialogue.zh: 貼一下那台讀卡機就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is asking for my pin now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈæskɪŋ fər maɪ pɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它現在要我的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it slowly, then press green.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ɪt ˈsloʊli, ðɛn prɛs ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢輸入，再按綠色鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Did the payment go through?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn! dɪd ðə ˈpeɪmənt ɡoʊ θru?/
dialogue.zh: 好了！付款有成功嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, listen, the receipt is printing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈlɪsən, ðə rɪˈsit ɪz ˈprɪntɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 有，你聽，收據正在印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I keep the paper copy?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ kip ðə ˈpeɪpər ˈkɑpi?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以留紙本收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, slip it in your wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, slɪp ɪt ɪn jʊr ˈwɑlət./
dialogue.zh: 當然，放進你的錢夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you run a rewards program?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju rʌn ə rɪˈwɔrdz ˈproʊɡræm?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有會員回饋活動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tenth stamp brings a free pie.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə tɛnθ stæmp brɪŋz ə fri paɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有的，集滿十個章就送一個派。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? How do I join that?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri? haʊ du aɪ dʒɔɪn ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 免費？我要怎麼加入？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can set that up for you here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn sɛt ðæt ʌp fər ju hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我就在這裡幫您辦好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It only needs my phone number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊnli nidz maɪ foʊn ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 只需要我的電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your first name too, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr fɜrst neɪm tu, ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 還有名字，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, please make me a member.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, pliz meɪk mi ə ˈmɛmbər./
dialogue.zh: 好，請幫我辦會員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your brand new card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz jʊr brænd nju kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 這是你的新會員卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the stamp go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə stæmp ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 章要蓋在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stamp it at every checkout.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stæmp ɪt æt ˈɛvri ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt./
dialogue.zh: 每次結帳我們都會蓋一個章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does today's shopping count already?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz təˈdeɪz ˈʃɑpɪŋ kaʊnt ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 今天的消費已經算進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One mark today, see the gold star?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɑrk təˈdeɪ, si ðə ɡoʊld stɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 今天蓋了一格，看到那顆金色星星了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine more and one free pie?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn mɔr ænd wʌn fri paɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 再九格就能換一個免錢的派？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It buys any item up to twelve dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt baɪz ˈɛni ˈaɪtəm ʌp tə twɛlv ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 可以換十二美元以內的任何商品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep that card safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ðæt kɑrd seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 我會好好收著這張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Members also get text offers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛmbərz ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt tɛkst ˈɔfərz./
dialogue.zh: 會員還會收到優惠簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the cake boxes charged extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə keɪk ˈbɑksɪz tʃɑrdʒd ˈɛkstrə?/
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕盒要另外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boxes are free, bags cost a quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑksɪz ɑr fri, bæɡz kɔst ə ˈkwɔrtər./
dialogue.zh: 盒子免費，袋子要二十五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quarter for one paper bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwɔrtər fər wʌn ˈpeɪpər bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 一個紙袋就要二十五分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plastic stays free if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplæstɪk steɪz fri ɪf ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 你要塑膠袋的話是免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the free plastic one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə fri ˈplæstɪk wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那我拿免費的塑膠袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One large bag, everything inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɑrdʒ bæɡ, ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 一個大袋，全部裝進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the bread away from cookies.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə brɛd əˈweɪ frʌm ˈkʊkiz./
dialogue.zh: 麵包要跟餅乾分開放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bread below, cookie box on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd bɪˈloʊ, ˈkʊkɪk bɑks ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 麵包在下，餅乾盒在上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slip the fruit tart into a tin.
dialogue.phonetic: /slɪp ðə frut tɑrt ˈɪntu ə tɪn./
dialogue.zh: 請把水果塔裝進鐵盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tins stop the crust from cracking.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪnz stɑp ðə krʌst frʌm ˈkrækɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 鐵盒可以防止塔皮裂開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a cooler bag today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈkulər bæɡ təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我今天需要保冷袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, it stays cool outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ, ɪt steɪz kul ˈaʊtˌsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不用，外面天氣涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the cream treats can travel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə krim trits kæn ˈtrævəl./
dialogue.zh: 那奶油點心就可以帶走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, keep them out of sunlight.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, kip ðɛm aʊt ʌv ˈsʌnˌlaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不過還是別曬到太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, are you closing soon already?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ɑr ju ˈkloʊzɪŋ sun ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 噢，你們很快就要打烊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We shut the doors at seven sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʌt ðə dɔrz æt ˈsɛvən ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 我們七點整關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I miss today's fresh donuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ mɪs təˈdeɪz frɛʃ ˈdoʊnəts?/
dialogue.zh: 我錯過今天的新鮮甜甜圈了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last six wait in that pink box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst sɪks weɪt ɪn ðæt pɪŋk bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 最後六個在那個粉紅盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they cheaper near closing time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðeɪ ˈtʃipər nɪr ˈkloʊzɪŋ taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 接近打烊會比較便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty percent off after six.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt ɔf ˈæftər sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 會，六點後打八折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock says six fifteen now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk sɛz sɪks ˈfɪftin naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 時鐘現在指六點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that box carries a sale sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðæt bɑks ˈkæriz ə seɪl ˈstɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 那盒已經貼上特價標了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the full box today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fər ðə fʊl bɑks təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天整盒多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four eighty, down from six dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈeɪkti, daʊn frʌm sɪks ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 四塊八，原價六美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the discount box please.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə dɪsˈkaʊnt bɑks pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請把折扣盒給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast hands! Those never last past six.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst hænz! ðoʊz ˈnɛvər læst pæst sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 手真快！那些從留不過六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any deals on yesterday's bread too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪ dilz ɑn ˈjɛstərˌdeɪz brɛd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 昨天的麵包有優惠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Day old loaves cost half price.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪ oʊd loʊvz kɔst hæf praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 隔夜麵包半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half price! Where do you hide them?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf praɪs! wɛr du ju haɪd ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 半價！你們把它們藏哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brown crate stands by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə braʊn kreɪt stændz baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 門邊那個棕色塑膠框。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spot one sourdough on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ spɑt wʌn ˈsaʊərˌdoʊ ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我看到最上面有一條酸種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the final discounted loaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði ˈfaɪnəl dɪsˈkaʊntɪd loʊf./
dialogue.zh: 那是最後一條折扣麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky me, two finds in one day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki mi, tu faɪndz ɪn wʌn deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我真幸運，一天找到兩樣寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday shoppers find the treasures.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈʃɑpərz faɪnd ðə ˈtrɛʒərz./
dialogue.zh: 週六的採購客總能找到寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the rewards card cover these?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə rɪˈwɔrdz kɑrd ˈkʌvərz ðiz?/
dialogue.zh: 這些也能用會員卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sale items earn marks too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, seɪl ˈaɪtmz ɜrn mɑrks tu./
dialogue.zh: 可以，特價品也能累計點數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then tap the card once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tæp ðə kɑrd wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那再感應一次卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beep, two stars now, nine to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /bip, tu stɑrz naʊ, naɪn tə ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 嗶，現在兩格，還差九格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay cash just for these?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ kæʃ dʒʌst fər ðiz?/
dialogue.zh: 這幾個我可以付現金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, box plus loaf, eight even.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, bɑks plʌs loʊf, eɪt ˈivən./
dialogue.zh: 好的，盒子加麵包，八美元整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is a ten dollar bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə tɛn ˈdɑlər bɪl./
dialogue.zh: 這是十美元紙鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the screen shows thirteen dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, ðə skrin ʃoʊz ˈθɜrtən ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 咦，螢幕上顯示十三美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirteen? That is five too many.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrtən? ðæt ɪz faɪv tu ˈmɛni./
dialogue.zh: 十三？那多了五塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One moment, I rang something twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn moˈmɛnt, aɪ ræŋ ˈsʌmˌθɪŋ twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 請稍等，我掃重了一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the fruit tart in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə frut tɑrt ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 水果塔怎麼會在上面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fruit tart got scanned twice, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frut tɑrt ɡɑt skænd twaɪs, ˈsɔri./
dialogue.zh: 水果塔被掃了兩次，真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid for that tart once already.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ peɪd fər ðæt tɑrt wʌns ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 那個塔我前面已經付過一次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fixed now, easy to miss, no trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪkst naʊ, ˈizi tə mɪs, noʊ ˈtrʌbəl./
dialogue.zh: 已經改好了，難免會看漏，不礙事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everything all settled now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɔl ˈsɛtəld naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在全部結清了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all done, best wishes to Mia.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɔl dʌn, bɛst ˈwɪʃɪz tə ˈmiə./
dialogue.zh: 都結清了，替我們祝米雅生日快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should these bags go for recycling?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd ðiz bæɡz ɡoʊ fər ˈrisaɪˌklɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 這些袋子該放哪裡回收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue bin waits outside left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu bɪn weɪts ˈaʊtˌsaɪd lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 外面左手邊有藍色回收桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the sidewalk stays so tidy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɑk steɪz soʊ ˈtaɪdi./
dialogue.zh: 真好，人行道保持整潔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A clean corner makes everyone smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə klin ˈkɔrnər meɪks ˈɛvriˌwʌn smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的街角讓人人開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I finish cake payment Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ keɪk ˈpeɪmənt ˈsʌnˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕的尾款週日再結嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the balance waits at pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈbæləns weɪts æt ˈpɪkˌʌp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，尾款取貨時付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you open early that Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈoʊpən ˈɜrli ðæt ˈsʌnˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個週日你們很早開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We open at seven thirty that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈoʊpən æt ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrti ðæt deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那週日我們七點半開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If we come late, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf wi kʌm leɪt, ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我們來晚了，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rests safe inside our cold room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɛsts seɪf ɪnˈsaɪd ˈaʊər koʊd rum./
dialogue.zh: 它會安全地待在冷藏室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank goodness, we are never early.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs, wi ɑr ˈnɛvər ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地，我們從不提早到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late guests find warm smiles here too.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt ɡɛsts faɪnd wɔrm smaɪlz hɪr tu./
dialogue.zh: 晚來的客人這裡也有溫暖的笑容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This card by the door, is it yours?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kɑrd baɪ ðə dɔr, ɪz ɪt jʊrz?/
dialogue.zh: 門邊這張卡是你們的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our birthday card, for any guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ kɑrd, fər ˈɛnɪ ɡɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我們的生日卡，誰都能寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May my wife and Mia sign it first?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ maɪ waɪf ænd ˈmiə saɪn ɪt fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 可以讓我太太和米雅先簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First line goes to the little one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst laɪn ɡoʊz tə ðə ˈlɪtəl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 第一行留給小壽星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also keep party napkins here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔlsoʊ kip ˈpɑrti ˈnæpkɪnz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡也賣派對餐巾紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, grab a free pack by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡræb ə fri pæk baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有，門口那邊拿一包免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have made my whole weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv meɪd maɪ hoʊl ˈwikˌɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 你讓我整個週末都好開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back Sunday, the cake awaits.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk ˈsʌnˌdeɪ, ðə keɪk əˈweɪts./
dialogue.zh: 週日回來吧，蛋糕在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodnight, see you at nine sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊdˈnaɪt, si ju æt naɪn ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，九點整見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, mind the cream on the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊdˈnaɪt, maɪnd ðə krim ɑn ðə draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，路上小心奶油會融。
